root_causes.description: Frontend pods experiencing extreme restart activity with z>1000, indicating repeated pod crashes during the incident window. This is the most anomalous signal across all swept metrics.

flagd service showing severe p99 latency spike of 10000ms (z=+7.59), far above the pre-incident baseline of ~4023ms. This latency anomaly is the second most dominant signal in the investigation window.

accounting service showing significant memory increase with z=+22.27, the third most anomalous signal. Memory usage window mean of 2.778e+08 bytes significantly exceeds the pre-incident baseline of 2.769e+08±3.8e+04 bytes.

remediation_steps: Investigate and restart frontend pods to stabilize the entry point service
Review flagd service configuration and recent deployments causing 10s latency
Check accounting pod resource limits and potential memory leak sources
